title: Arattai gets MapmyIndia integration for instant mapping! #Shorts
description:
Learn how to use Zoho Arattai's new MapmyIndia integration to open shared location pins directly inside Mappls without switching apps.

1. Open a chat in Zoho's Arattai messaging app
2. Tap on the received shared location pin
3. Launch it directly inside the Mappls navigation interface

lines.say: Zoho just launched MapmyIndia integration in Arattai to fix clunky location sharing. Now, instead of struggling with complicated workarounds when sharing locations across messaging apps, you can easily open shared location pins directly inside Mappls. Let's walk through how this powerful new feature works step by step.

lines.say: Sharing locations across messaging apps usually requires clunky workarounds, forcing you to copy coordinates or switch manually between different navigation platforms every single time you receive a pin from someone.
